source.source: Kite historical BANKNIFTY index minute candles

methodology.entries: All rolling levels and directional-change thresholds are known before the triggering minute
methodology.fills: Stop entry fills at known trigger or adverse gap-open price
methodology.stops: Existing stops are checked before new trailing levels; entry-minute stop is assumed hit when ordering is uncertain
methodology.trails: A trail calculated from a minute applies after that minute; a crossed calculated trail exits at minute close
methodology.ambiguity: If both entry directions touch in one minute, no favourable ordering is assumed and no profit is credited
methodology.positionLimit: One index-equivalent position at a time
methodology.limitation: BANKNIFTY index-point proxy, not historical futures-contract fills
